_schema: Defect reference for one ABAP source. Report-agnostic: it describes the
source, not any report, so it stays valid as reports change.
source   the file these defects were read out of, relative to Test-source/real
id        stable identifier, referenced by verdict files
area      which part of the program the defect lives in
question  phrased so a judge can decide yes/partial/no from the
report text alone, without guessing at intent
anchor    the source text that makes the defect checkable; some
Score a report with:  python scripts/evaluate.py score --defects THIS.json \

D21 onward added by reading the source: the list was too small for the measurement. Relative noise is absolute disagreement divided by defect count, so at 20 defects two reports differing by three items is 15 percent, which is the size of every effect this project has claimed. Judge variance was measured at zero over three independent judgements of one report, so the noise is generation and the only lever is the denominator.

defects.question: Does the report identify that zzstjah is filled from the current line item's fiscal year (<ls_items>-gjahr) while zzstblg comes from a *different* (referenced) document, so a cross-year reversal writes a key pointing at a non-existent document?

Does the report identify that the SELECT SINGLE belnr FROM bkpf WHERE awtyp/awkey suppresses the multiple-rows finding with ##WARN_OK, so when several BKPF rows match one awkey the stored zzstblg is an arbitrary one of them?

Does the report identify that READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY is used against table keys declared NON-UNIQUE (tt_mseg mblnr/mjahr, tt_rbkp belnr/gjahr, tt_vbrp vbeln) — a key misuse that is an activation error or returns an arbitrary first match?
defects.anchor: READ TABLE lt_mseg WITH TABLE KEY mblnr = <ls_items>-zzawkey(10)

defects.question: Does the report identify that lv_awkey is only cleared inside the three IF sy-subrc = 0 branches, so line items whose zzawtyp is none of MKPF/RMRP/VBRK reuse the previous row's awkey and get a foreign document number written into zzstblg?

Does the report identify that IF sy-subrc <> 0 after ENDLOOP does not test whether the opening-balance loop found anything, but the leftover sy-subrc of the last statement executed inside the loop body (READ TABLE / nested LOOP), so the 'no devir' branch is decided by unrelated code?

Does the report identify that the dynamically assigned field symbols <lv_vari> and <lv_x_aisel> are dereferenced (CS 'EKSTRE', <> abap_true) without any IS ASSIGNED check, so a failed ASSIGN raises CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL?

Does the report identify that the dynamic field name target is only 5 characters (lv_fname(5)) while CONCATENATE 'BLAR' ls_bseg-koart needs 4+4 characters, so the name is truncated and SELECT SINGLE (lv_fname) returns no field, leaving BLART initial because sy-subrc is never checked?

Does the report identify that lv_mode is initialised to 'E' (ALLGAZMD exercise/test run), i.e. POSTING_INTERFACE_CLEARING only tests the clearing and never creates the document, while the method still reports success via MESSAGE?

defects.question: Does the report identify that determine_due_date never checks sy-subrc of the BSEG SELECT SINGLE and swallows the FM's exceptions in an empty ##NEEDED branch, returning the uninitialised e_faede-netdt as a valid due date?

Does the report identify that WRITE iv_datum TO lv_datxt converts the date into the calling user's display format before it is handed to CONVERSION_EXIT_INVDT_INPUT (which expects the internal format), and that the wrong conversion result is then stored in the class-wide cache (and the FM's conversion exception is not caught)?

Does the report identify that INSERT ls_cache INTO TABLE gt_dg_cache ASSIGNING <ls_cache> targets a table with UNIQUE KEY, so a duplicate key leaves the field symbol unassigned and rv_gdatu = <ls_cache>-gdatu dereferences it, and that this class-data cache is unbounded and never invalidated?

defects.question: Does the report identify that the customer branch of get_iban_codes selects kna1~lifnr and filters kna1~lifnr IN @it_kunnr although KNA1 has no LIFNR field, and that the three OPTIONAL range parameters are used unconditionally as ranges so an unsupplied range means 'no restriction'?

Does the report identify that rt_blart = VALUE #( FOR ... ) builds a plain list that is assigned to tt_blart (HASHED with UNIQUE KEY table_line), so a document type occurring more than once in zfit_ith_blart raises CX_SY_DUPLICATE_KEY at runtime instead of being deduplicated?

Does the report identify that get_domestic_import_doc_types filters WHERE is_foreign = abap_true AND is_domestic = abap_true, i.e. the intersection instead of 'domestic only', returning an almost necessarily empty set under a name that promises domestic types?

Does the report identify that lv_keydt = <ls_budat>-low - 1 underflows to 99999999 when the selection range's low bound is empty (turning 'budat LE keydt' into 'all history') and that only INDEX 1 of the range is considered?

Does the report identify that validate_zhrtip writes the selected mandt into the system field sy-mandt via `INTO @sy-mandt`, overwriting the session's client field as a side effect of a validation check?

Does the report identify that the two account-type checks in validate_zhrtip read different offsets of iv_zhrtip -- `iv_zhrtip(2)` for the '5' case but `iv_zhrtip+1(2)` for the '9' case -- so the second check inspects characters 2-3 where GOKART/BLART occupies 1-2?

Does the report identify that validate_zhrtip substrings iv_zhrtip at a fixed offset with no length check on the parameter, so a value shorter than the offset raises a substring runtime error instead of failing the validation cleanly?

Does the report identify that check_iban_duplicate inspects only `lt_tiban[ 1 ]` while get_iban_codes APPENDINGs rows from up to two separate SELECTs, so a duplicate in any row beyond the first is not detected?

Does the report identify that the COND expressions building `party` and `party_type` for zcx_fi_iban have no ELSE branch, so a matched TIBAN row with neither KUNNR nor LIFNR filled raises the duplicate exception with an empty party and empty party_type?

defects.question: Does the report identify that both SELECTs in get_iban_codes suppress the ATC check with `##TOO_MANY_ITAB_FIELDS` while selecting `tiban~*`, so the field count against the target structure is never verified and every TIBAN field is moved into the result table?

Does the report identify that get_iban_codes searches only inside `IF iv_get_vendor IS NOT INITIAL` and `IF iv_get_client IS NOT INITIAL`, so when neither flag is set it returns an empty table without raising, and check_iban_duplicate then treats 'never searched' as 'no duplicate'?

Does the report identify that clear_customer_open_items wraps its whole BDC body in `TRY. ... ENDTRY.` with no CATCH, so every failure from the F-32 clearing -- including a submit error -- is swallowed and the caller is told the open items were cleared?

Does the report identify that clear_customer_open_items ends the BDC with `=WAIT_USER`, which blocks on an interactive popup and is not permitted in background or BAPI/BOI mode, so the method cannot run unattended?

Does the report identify that in denklestirerek_transfer_kaydi the BKPF header values are collected with ftpost only while `IF sy-tabix = 1.`, so every field value posted -- BUKRS, BLART, BLDAT, BUDAT, XBLNR, WAERS -- comes from the first BSEG row while lt_ftclear receives a clearing row for every row?

Does the report identify that in the RFITEMGL branch of devir_fblxn the umskz and filkd columns are commented out of the bsis and bsas field lists, while the RFITEMAP branch selects both, so umskz and filkd reach the aggregation initial for every general-ledger account?

Does the report identify that devir_fblxn guards every field symbol in the first CASE with IS ASSIGNED but for the RFITEMGL account range checks only `IF sy-subrc = 0.`, so an assigned yet empty range matches nothing and the general-ledger opening balances are silently omitted?

Does the report identify that the second statement in ekstre_fblxn's reversal block is `DELETE ct_items.` with no WHERE clause, inside the LOOP that iterates ct_items, so it removes every remaining row of the item table rather than only the current document?

Does the report identify that ekstre_fblxn writes zzbstkd from zuonr inside a LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL, so a component that participates in the table's sort order is changed while the loop is walking that order?

Does the report identify that the BSIK, BSAK, BSID and BSAD selects in devir_fblxn combine FOR ALL ENTRIES with a parenthesised OR comparing lifnr against it_hesap-sube or it_hesap-merkez, so the per-row correlation with the driver row is lost and the join degrades to a filtered cross product?
